item.title: Bigg Boss Marathi Season 6 ropes in nine sponsors led by Santoor and Danube
item.description: Nine companies, including Danube Properties, Santoor, MYK Laticrete, Pitambari, P. N. Gadgil & Sons, Gemini Cooking Oil, Cotton King, Society Tea and Tunwal E-Motors, join the show for the season

item.title: Airtel Business elevates Shreyas Mehrotra to Chief Marketing Officer
item.description: Mehrotra’s elevation follows his leadership across marketing, digital sales and category strategy at Airtel, alongside prior roles spanning telecom and consumer brands

item.title: boAt names Sammyak Jain Business Head to oversee global operations
item.description: In his expanded role, Jain will oversee boAt’s international business, including market entry and expansion, while continuing to lead enterprise and ODM sales

item.title: Virat Kohli revisits his World Cup recovery journey in Duroflex campaign film
item.description: The film documents Kohli’s recovery routine during the ICC Men’s Cricket World Cup 2023, focusing on the role of sleep consistency across match locations in supporting performance under pressure

item.title: Piyal Das joins Kapiva as Head of Creative and Director, Marketing
item.description: Former Leo Burnett creative director Das joins Kapiva to lead its creative and marketing functions, bringing experience across agency and brand-side roles

item.title: Eternal says ‘no change in business model’ after Blinkit updates delivery branding
item.description: The company said the revised tagline reflects a broader assortment and delivery promise, following exchange queries and reports questioning ultra-fast delivery expectations

item.title: India Today Group brings Tak 360 to FAST and connected TV screens
item.description: The connected TV channel integrates hyperlocal, national and global reporting, offering round-the-clock news across genres for digital-first audiences

item.title: IBDF pitches Budget 2026 tax reset; seeks 5% GST on TV, OTT subscriptions
item.description: Flags liquidity stress in linear TV, seeks LTU-like GST mechanism, and pushes direct-tax fixes on mergers, transponder hire disputes, refunds and Form 10F

item.title: India’s creative economy faces key copyright and governance questions as AI adoption accelerates
item.description: At a pre-summit seminar ahead of the India AI Impact Summit 2026, policymakers and industry leaders examined copyright, licensing and governance shaping AI’s role in India’s creative economy
